about_the_game: The 2017 Hot Pass for NASCAR Heat 2 keeps you up to date with 7 expansion packs that add new paint schemes, challenges, spotters, custom car templates, and other enhancements to keep your game fresh!  Includes all additional in game content available by 12/31/17.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 530 or AMD FX 4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 460 or AMD HD 5870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Soundcards
